reference_prolog:
:- format("Label: ~w~n", ["no"]).
% HousingQA: New Hampshire, 2021

state(new_hampshire).

qa_item(
    new_hampshire,
    "In an eviction action, can a tenant rebut/raise the defense that unpaid rent was lawfully withheld? This includes where the law allows a tenant to procure reasonable alternative housing due to lack of repairs or services, and was excused from paying rent, or where the law allows a tenant to abate rent either in part or in full due to lack of repairs."
).

% Statutes from N.H. REV. STAT.  540 series
statute(nh_rev_stat_540_2_vi).
statute(nh_rev_stat_540_2_vii_f).
statute(nh_rev_stat_540_13_iii).
statute(nh_rev_stat_540_13_a).
statute(nh_rev_stat_540_13_d_i).

statute_of_state(nh_rev_stat_540_2_vi, new_hampshire).
statute_of_state(nh_rev_stat_540_2_vii_f, new_hampshire).
statute_of_state(nh_rev_stat_540_13_iii, new_hampshire).
statute_of_state(nh_rev_stat_540_13_a, new_hampshire).
statute_of_state(nh_rev_stat_540_13_d_i, new_hampshire).

% nh_rev_stat_540_2_vi: Tenant may withhold rent if forced to pay utilities
allows_withholding_for_utilities(nh_rev_stat_540_2_vi) :-
    true. % Base statute: if conditions met, tenant can withhold rent for utility payments

% nh_rev_stat_540_2_vii_f: Affirmative defense in possessory actions (eviction)
defense_as_affirmative(nh_rev_stat_540_2_vii_f, allows_withholding_for_utilities).

% nh_rev_stat_540_13_d_i: Defense to possessory action if premises in violation of health/safety standards
allows_withholding_for_repairs(nh_rev_stat_540_13_d_i) :-
    true. % Statute explicitly excuses rent payment when premises unhabitable due to violations

% nh_rev_stat_540_13_iii: Court shall consider tenant's defenses in rent claims
court_considers_defenses(nh_rev_stat_540_13_iii).

% nh_rev_stat_540_13_a: Retaliation defense (supports ability to raise rent withholding as defense)
allows_retaliation_defense(nh_rev_stat_540_13_a).

% Define key predicates for rent withholding defenses
lawful_withholding_of_rent(State, Law) :-
    statute_of_state(Law, State),
    ( allows_withholding_for_utilities(Law)
    ; allows_withholding_for_repairs(Law) ).

defense_allowed_in_eviction(State) :-
    statute_of_state(Law, State),
    lawful_withholding_of_rent(State, Law),
    ( defense_as_affirmative(Law, _) ; court_considers_defenses(Law) ; allows_retaliation_defense(Law) ).

% Main predicate: does state law allow tenant to raise defense of lawful rent withholding in eviction?
state_allows_withholding_defense(State) :-
    state(State),
    defense_allowed_in_eviction(State).

question_predicate(
    "In an eviction action, can a tenant rebut/raise the defense that unpaid rent was lawfully withheld? This includes where the law allows a tenant to procure reasonable alternative housing due to lack of repairs or services, and was excused from paying rent, or where the law allows a tenant to abate rent either in part or in full due to lack of repairs.",
    state_allows_withholding_defense
).

derived_answer(yes) :-
    qa_item(State, Question),
    question_predicate(Question, Pred),
    Goal =.. [Pred, State],
    call(Goal), !.

derived_answer(no) :-
    qa_item(State, Question),
    question_predicate(Question, Pred),
    Goal =.. [Pred, State],
    \+ call(Goal).

housing_answer(yes) :- derived_answer(yes).
housing_answer(no) :- derived_answer(no).

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).

:- initialization(main, main).
